title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire in the Nyamagabe, Nyaruguru and Rulindo regions of Rwanda, contributes to outcome 3.1 Women and older adolescent girls experience increased safety, psychosocial wellbeing, and meaningful participation and leadership. The objective is that women, older adolescent girls and GBV survivors use GBV specialised interventions and psychosocial support to meet their needs and preferences. Activities include strengthening GBV referral pathways; awareness raising sessions on the GBV legal framework and referrals; and the provision of psychosocial support to GBV survivors. The programme is in partnership with ARCT-Ruhuka, Haguruka and RCSP. . OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 3.1 Women and older adolescent girls experience increased safety, psychosocial wellbeing, and meaningful participation and leadership. . SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The principal focus of this outcome is:Women’s protection and access to specialised GBV supports
